findings.evidence: Lines 263-265 and 272-274: `cases l <;> ext <;> simp [...]` then `all_goals congr 1; field_simp`.
findings.fix: Make the `simp` terminal per component: prove the `x` component separately with an explicit `div_eq_div_iff`/`field_simp` step on a named intermediate equality, instead of `congr 1` on whatever simp produced.
findings.issue: `cases l <;> ext <;> simp only [...] <;> simp [...]` is non-terminal and is followed by `all_goals congr 1; field_simp` (same shape at line 274 in `mixedMethod_eq_trueInvariants_of_photon_eq_zero`). Which goals the `simp` closes and what shape it leaves for `congr 1` is invisible to the reader and changes with any Mathlib simp-set change; `congr 1` on an equation of real quotients is structure-dependent and can split into unprovable subgoals.

findings.evidence: Lines 377-378 and 412-413; denominators are `2 * (g e.p e.k - g e.p e.kPrime)` (electron `x`) and the `y_Σ`/`y` denominators, all zero under `h`.
findings.fix: Either add the non-degeneracy hypothesis (`g e.p (e.pX - e.p) ≠ 0`) to the statement, or keep the split with a comment stating that in this branch both sides are the junk value `0` of division by zero.
findings.issue: Undocumented junk-value branch: `rcases eq_or_ne (g e.p e.k - g e.p e.kPrime) 0 with h | h · simp [h]` closes the degenerate case only because `a / 0 = 0` makes both sides zero — i.e. the stated identity is vacuous there, not true for a physical reason. Same pattern at line 412 in `sigmaMethod_x_eq_trueInvariants_x_of_collinear` (`rcases eq_or_ne (z * g e.p e.k - g e.p e.kPrime) 0`).

findings.evidence: Lines 333-335, 353-355, 371-375, 408-411, 437-438 contain the same simp-only list; 376-381 and 412-416 the same case-split/field_simp tail.
findings.fix: Factor the collinear normalization into private lemmas stated once, e.g. `g e.p (e.pX - e.p) = z * g e.p e.k - g e.p e.kPrime` and the explicit values of `(e.trueInvariants g .initialState).Q2/.x/.y`, and rewrite with those.
findings.issue: The same ~12-name normalization block (`DisKinematics.*, hardKinematics_*, leptonIn_of_collinear, pX_sub_p_of_collinear, map_sub, map_smul, LinearMap.sub_apply, LinearMap.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hk, hk'`) is repeated verbatim at lines 333-335, 353-355, 371-375, 408-411 and 437-438, each time re-deriving the collinear scalar products inline; the shared tail (degenerate split, `mul_comm` restatement, `field_simp; ring`) is duplicated at 376-381 and 412-416.

findings.evidence: Lines 375-379 (`... at hy ⊢`, `(div_ne_zero_iff.mp hy).1`, `rwa [mul_comm]`) and line 414.
findings.fix: Derive the nonvanishing hypothesis from an explicitly stated lemma about `(e.trueInvariants g .initialState).y` (the factored lemma suggested above) rather than from simp's output shape, and drop the `mul_comm` restatements by giving `field_simp` the hypothesis in the form it needs.
findings.issue: `have hzk : z * g e.p e.k - g e.p e.kPrime ≠ 0 := (div_ne_zero_iff.mp hy).1` extracts a numerator fact from `hy` only after `hy` was rewritten by the big `simp only ... at hy ⊢`, so it depends on the exact syntactic form simp leaves; likewise `have hzk' := by rwa [mul_comm]` (and line 414) exists only to match `field_simp`'s argument order.

findings.evidence: `AccessMethods.lean:127` `lemma ySigma_eq_yInel ... : d.ySigma g_met = K.yInel g_met`; its hypotheses `K.p = e.p`, `K.kPrime = e.kPrime`, `e.p + (e.k - e.photon) = e.pX + e.kPrime` all hold for `e.hardKinematics .initialState` by `RadiativeEvent.conservation`.
findings.fix: Apply `SigmaMethodData.ySigma_eq_yInel ⟨e.pX, e.kPrime, e.p⟩ g (e.hardKinematics .initialState) rfl rfl (conservation)` instead of unfolding; same for the `hy` step at 260-262.
findings.issue: `rw [sigmaMethod_y, SigmaMethodData.ySigma, ← map_add, h]` unfolds the `ySigma` definition by hand, as does line 262 in the Born-limit proof, although `SigmaMethodData.ySigma_eq_yInel` already proves exactly `d.ySigma g = K.yInel g` under momentum conservation.

summary: The collinear and Born-limit proofs rest on non-terminal `simp` followed by `congr 1`/`field_simp` and on undocumented division-by-zero branches that close only because Lean's `/` returns junk; the same 12-lemma normalization block and degenerate-case tail are copy-pasted across five proofs instead of being factored, and two Sigma proofs unfold `ySigma` by hand instead of using the existing `ySigma_eq_yInel`.
